method: Every evidence bbox selects original native glyph clusters by physical glyph center, independently of whole-page substring. Whole-region equality is checked first, then physical x order for split text objects. Overlapping font boxes are verified against one unique actual glyph baseline and all overlaps are recorded. No dictionary/wording replacement, bbox repair or paint-visibility claim.

overlapping_regions.disposition: Original font bbox contains neighboring baseline; target glyphs verified without cropping, deleting or merging neighboring content.
